name: providex
description: Language support for Sage ProvideX (Sage 100 / MAS 90): syntax highlighting, language server (diagnostics, completion, hover, signature help, go to definition, references, rename, symbols, folding, formatting, semantic tokens) and integration with an installed ProvideX to decompile, compile, syntax-check and run programs.

commands.title: Make Readable (hide statement numbers, one statement per line)

providex.home.markdownDescription: ProvideX home directory (the folder containing `pvxwin32.exe` and `Lib`), e.g. `C:\Sage\Sage 100\MAS90\Home`. Leave empty to auto-detect.

providex.executable.markdownDescription: Path to `pvxwin32.exe` used by **Run Program**. Defaults to `<home>\pvxwin32.exe`.

providex.runArguments.markdownDescription: Extra ProvideX command-line options placed before the program name by **Run Program** (e.g. `-hd` to run hidden, or an INI file).

providex.bridge.enabled.markdownDescription: Use the installed ProvideX (via the `ProvideX.Script` COM server) for syntax checking, compiling and decompiling.

providex.diagnostics.useProvideX.markdownDescription: When to validate the document with the real ProvideX compiler (in addition to the built-in analyzer).

providex.diagnostics.undefinedLabels.description: Report GOTO/GOSUB/ERR= references to labels or statement numbers that do not exist.

providex.diagnostics.unusedLabels.description: Report labels that are never referenced.

providex.diagnostics.blockStructure.description: Report unbalanced FOR/NEXT, WHILE/WEND, REPEAT/UNTIL, SWITCH/END SWITCH, braces, DEF CLASS/END DEF.

providex.format.keywordCase.description: Case applied to directives, functions and system variables when formatting.

providex.format.indentBlocks.description: Indent statements inside blocks when formatting code without statement numbers (ProvideX does not store indentation).

providex.format.indentSize.description: Spaces per indentation level when providex.format.indentBlocks is enabled.

providex.compile.outputExtension.description: Extension used for the compiled program when compiling a text source file (the compiled file is written next to the source).

providex.compile.onSave.description: Automatically compile text source files when saved.

providex.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the ProvideX language server.

providex.classPath.markdownDescription: Additional folders searched for compiled class programs (`DEF CLASS`) used for member completion, hover and navigation (e.g. Sage 100 module folders). The `MAS90` folder next to `providex.home` is searched automatically.

providex.programArguments.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to the program by **Run Program** (after `-ARG`; read them with `ARG(1)`, `ARG(2)`, …).

enumDescriptions: Hide statement numbers (jump targets become labels), one statement per line, single-line IF ... ELSE expanded into blocks, indented and spaced. Numbers are restored on save; unchanged statements keep their original numbers.
ProvideX/TS: TypeScript-style syntax (braces, // comments, obj.Method(), functions with local scope). Lossless: saved back as ProvideX.
Show the program exactly as ProvideX LISTs it.
providex.compiledView.markdownDescription: How compiled programs are shown when opened as source.

providex.readable.splitStatements.description: Readable view: put each statement of a multi-statement line (A=1; B=2) on its own line.

providex.readable.expandIf.description: Readable view: expand single-line IF c THEN a; b ELSE d into IF c THEN { ... } ELSE { ... } blocks (exactly equivalent in ProvideX).

providex.readable.omitLet.description: Readable view: hide the implied LET that ProvideX inserts on every assignment (it is re-inserted on compile).

providex.readable.spacing.description: Readable view: spaces around operators and after commas.

providex.format.spacing.description: Format Document: normalize spacing around operators and after commas (ProvideX discards whitespace, so this never changes the compiled program).

providex.compiled.confirmSave.description: Ask before the first save of a compiled program in a session (the original is always backed up to <file>.bak).

scripts.package: npm run grammar && npm run build -- --production && vsce package --no-dependencies
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run grammar && npm run build -- --production
scripts.extract: node scripts/dump-raw.mjs raw && node scripts/build-lexicon.mjs raw && node scripts/build-grammar.mjs
scripts.test:vscode: node scripts/build.mjs && esbuild test/vscode/suite.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:vscode --outfile=out/vscode/suite.js && esbuild test/vscode/runTest.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=out/vscode/runTest.js && node out/vscode/runTest.js
